title: For each department, what is the department name and the standard deviation
question: For each department, what is the department name and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only departments with more than 5 subjects, where the school name is 'Engineering', and the department is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' (Course 6)? Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
SELECT 
    sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units
FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd
JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso 
    ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering'
    AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'
    AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '6'
GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
HAVING COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) > 5
